title: House Democratic leader attacks Trump and Republican domestic agenda
text:
Donald Trump and his extreme Republican allies have been a complete failure at home and abroad. They promised peace and lower living costs but instead delivered chaos, corruption, higher prices, and a weaker economy. Republicans in Congress refuse to stand up for the American people while the president abandons his promises and pushes an agenda written for wealthy interests.

Their tax and spending plan is an assault on health care. It would take Medicaid support from children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities while threatening hospitals, nursing homes, and community clinics. Millions could lose coverage or pay more so billionaires can receive another tax break. Democrats will fight this cruel plan and defend affordable care, working families, and communities that Republican leaders have left behind.
source: Office of the House Democratic Leader
